story: Transmits AM radio on computers without radio transmitting hardware
text: I was browsing YouTube the other day, and got recommended something similar: [VIDEO] Very interesting indeed! The title of the video translates to "Electromagnetic festival music".
Reminds me of Electronicos Fantasticos (Japan) who re-purposes old items (TV's old fans, barcode scanners etc...) and makes electronic music. Super interesting stuff! [VIDEO]

story: Ask HN: Any Interesting Niche Hobbies?
text: I dig the electroduotone. Congrats! Have you heard of electronicos fantasticos? It's this band from Japan who make incredible music with instruments they made themselves. [VIDEO]
Actually I did stumble across it on my "weird music instruments" rabbithole last night! They also figured out how to somehow play TVs and a space heater as guitars?? [VIDEO]
